rationale: Bolaji brings hands-on infrastructure and tooling expertise from Cohere with a strong foundation in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, while Rakesh's AI research background at Meta represents the research layer that informs production systems. Their complementary skill sets—infrastructure engineering paired with AI research—create potential for exploring how cutting-edge research translates into scalable tooling and infrastructure.
intro_message: Bolaji, meet Rakesh Ranjan — he's doing AI research at Meta and you're building infrastructure and tooling at Cohere, so you two could have an interesting conversation about bridging research and production systems.
